physical_pools.name: Chaos Spawn — shared cross-faction pool

physical_configuration.allocation_rule: Any physical Spawn allocated to one roster is unavailable to another simultaneous roster unless separate bodies remain.

notes: The user confirmed a single global pool of ten physical Chaos Spawn used across multiple Chaos armies.
Styling is a hobby/visual property and does not create separate ownership pools.
One model is Khorne-styled, two are Tzeentch-styled and seven are visually universal.
The old World Eaters roster selection of six Spawn is a roster allocation over this pool, not evidence of six World Eaters-owned Spawn.
Build/paint state was not separately stated and is intentionally left unresolved.

constraints.effect: The ten Chaos Spawn are owned once globally. Faction inventories may reference and allocate them but must not add them to faction-unique physical-body totals.

open_questions.question: Which of the ten shared Chaos Spawn are assembled, painted, partially built or otherwise unfinished?

facts: Ten Chaos Spawn are owned across all Chaos collections.
Seven have a standard/universal Chaos appearance.
The models are used by multiple Chaos armies and must not be assigned as separate duplicate bodies to individual faction collections.

notes: This domain exists to prevent cross-faction double-counting of physical models used by several Chaos armies.
Current datasheet legality and faction access are rules-layer questions and remain separate from physical ownership.
